summary.text: Adam Bowling is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 87 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Adam Bowling lived in Middlesboro, Kentucky, as of March 2020, and earned a bachelor of arts in economics from Wofford College.
His career experience includes working as the owner of Bowkirk Medical, LLC.
Bowling took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2019, succeeding Rick Nelson.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Appropriations and Revenue Committee and was also assigned to the Economic Development and Workforce Investment Committee and the Natural Resources and Energy Committee.
